name: Roman numerals
description: Convert between Roman numerals and numbers.
solve: function solve(q){const R=[[1000,'M'],[900,'CM'],[500,'D'],[400,'CD'],[100,'C'],[90,'XC'],[50,'L'],[40,'XL'],[10,'X'],[9,'IX'],[5,'V'],[4,'IV'],[1,'I']];const n=q.match(/\b(\d{1,4})\b/);const r=q.match(/\b([MDCLXVI]{1,15})\b/)||q.match(/\b([mdclxvi]{2,15})\b/);if(n&&+n[1]>0&&+n[1]<4000&&!/\bto (a )?number\b/i.test(q)){let v=+n[1],o='';const steps=[];for(const[k,s]of R)while(v>=k){o+=s;v-=k;steps.push(`${s} = ${k}`)}return{answer:`${n[1]} = ${o}`,steps}}if(r){const s=r[1].toUpperCase(),V={I:1,V:5,X:10,L:50,C:100,D:500,M:1000};let t=0;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){const a=V[s[i]],b=V[s[i+1]]||0;t+=a<b?-a:a}return{answer:`${s} = ${t}`,steps:[`Add each value, subtracting any that come before a larger one: ${t}`]}}return{answer:null,reason:'No number or numeral found.'}}
